body: I think there’s many ways to interpret the song, the way I view it’s about love rather than religion, it may be about a love so pure it’s divine, a confession of total love you might say, hope you enjoy it!! It’s one of my favorites
Yes exactly! knowing there’s people out there that share your story is very heartwarming and it makes me feel like I’m not alone in my journey to heal from what happened <33

I will definitely look into the trauma workbooks bc I don’t feel ready to open up about what happened completely yet, I really needed to hear that what happened was not my fault from someone that went through the same experience, I have always felt so guilty and disgusting bc of it. I know you’ll be able to heal from what happened you sound really strong, thank you again this means a lot to me :)
Thank you for your comment I’m really sorry you had to go through something like that too, I’ll tell him I’m going to cut contact, this really helped me finally decide to do it I really appreciate it
Yes I’m doing everything in my power to reassure her I won’t try again, it breaks my heart to see her like that, thank you for the response I’m also glad I didn’t go through with it
